title that runs windows games on a ps5 from a desktop of their own mihawk os. it is still experimental at a glance what s new big games with steam open. steam s built-in browser now pauses while you play, freeing room on the console. resident evil 3 s demo runs through steam on a standard ps5 memory limits made for your console. mihawkos recognises your model and real firmware and sets its limits from them: original and slim ps5s below 12.00 get far more room than before a warning, then a clean close, instead of a crash. when the console runs short, you are warned first; if a game still runs installers start their programs faster in this release steam and big games memory made for your console payload checklist fixes played on the console known limits installing or updating source and credits big games with steam open the console keeps a fixed number of page tables , the records it uses to track memory. steam s built-in browser alone used more than half of what steam needed, and a large game could not start beside it steam s browser pauses while you play. when a game from your steam library starts, mihawkos pauses steam s browser; when the game ends, the browser comes back and big picture returns as it was. this works for every game in your steam library, with no list to maintain what it frees: on a ps5 pro with a game running, page tables in use fell from about 6,100 to about 4,910 steam keeps working while it is paused: it stays signed in, the game stays licensed, and cloud saves are written when the game ends already set up steam? your steam entry gets the new rule automatically; nothing to redo resident evil 3: raccoon city demo, through steam standard ps5 13.60 : it plays without crashing, with some hitches ps5 pro 10.01 : five minutes in game at about 23-46 frames a second, at least 4,909 page tables left free memory made for your console volunteers on original, slim and pro consoles, from firmware 5.50 to 13.60, ran a memory test that found where each console starts to struggle. thank you to everyone who did. mihawkos now uses those results it recognises your console: original, slim or pro, and the firmware actually installed, even when your tools report a different version limits per console original or slim, firmware 12.00 and later a warning appears at: about 1,750 mib; alpha 4 stopped at: 1,800 mib original or slim, below 12.00 a warning appears at: about 1,650 mib; alpha 4 stopped at: 990 mib ps5 pro, any firmware a warning appears at: about 850 mib and a clean stop at 950 mib ; alpha 4 stopped at: 990 or 1,800 mib a warning first, a clean close last. past the warning, an original or slim console starts to swap; the game gets slower but keeps going. mihawkos closes it cleanly, back to the launcher, only when the game stalls or new programs start much slower a safety net for the page tables. if they run low, the game is closed cleanly before the console runs out instead of a crash know what your payloads cost. the launcher shows how much memory your payloads used in your last session, and says when closing them would free room a payload checklist at start most problems testers sent came from a different set of payloads. mihawkos now opens only with the official set, and shows a checklist page that says what to load or close kstuff lite 1.11 beta or later required shadowmountplus 1.7beta10 or later required websrv required nanodns required elfldr required klog, ftpsrv, pldmgr allowed anything else close it first: it takes memory your games need shadowmountplus 1.7beta6 and later already include the fix that lets the webui s home-screen tiles keep working, so no extra tool is needed for it fixes reported by players no more black screen after restoring steam s window games no longer crash when they switch to fullscreen. the binding of isaac, which asks for a picture one pixel wider than the screen, now plays its intro and runs at about 61 frames a second errno 92 after an update: if your console still holds an older windows runtime, mihawkos now notices on every start, however you launch it, and offers to install the right one, instead of failing with errno 92. the helper that starts windows programs now ships inside the app folder, so it always matches your mihawkos steam closing before its sign-in screen: a windows setup whose first install never finished could not see the network, so steam gave up after 30 seconds. mihawkos now finishes that install itself on the next start resident evil 3 finds your dualsense on its own , without choosing a controller in the launcher first every log names its build: the app, the runtime and the helper, so a report shows at a glance what it was faster installers and launchers start their programs faster: a helper is ready in 0.03 s instead of 0.2 s, and its windows parts load in 0.37 s instead of 0.59 s closer to windows: wine s own test suite, run on the console and compared with a pc: 1,410 of 1,708 test files match 1,337 in alpha 4 . 428361297.body: a hotfix for alpha 5. if mihawkos showed every payload as missing even though they were loaded, or games could not start with no access to data , this fixes it. everything else is the same as alpha 5 what s fixed mihawkos gets its access to data even when dev.conf is missing or points somewhere unreachable. its access helper used to quit at once when it could not reach its log server set in data homebrew dev.conf , so mihawkos never got access to your files. the helper now keeps running and writes its log to a file instead. you no longer need to create or fix dev.conf the payload checklist tells you what s really wrong. when mihawkos cannot see your payloads because it has no access to data , the checklist no longer calls every payload missing . it says what is blocking it, and how to fix it played on the console standard ps5, firmware 13.60, with the payloads loaded through payload manager a dev.conf pointing at an address nobody answers the reported case : the access helper kept running mihawkos got data , and the payload checklist passed the full test battery of 104 cases: 102 passed, the other two skipped by a test-network setting alpha5-hotfix-base-2026-10-29-01 . the payload checklist passed at every one of its 143 starts installing or updating new install: the same as alpha 5: copy ppsa99170 to data homebrew , open mihawkos, and the guided setup installs the runtime from a usb drive or over ftp updating from alpha 5 or alpha 4 1. replace the ppsa99170 folder in data homebrew with the new one 2. put the new runtime pieces on your usb drive the mihawkos folder from the runtime zip , or have them ready for ftp 3. open mihawkos from its own icon. it sees that the runtime belongs to the previous build and offers to install the new one 4. restart the ps5 , load your payloads, and open mihawkos your prefix, your games in c: games , steam and your settings are kept ps5 mihawkos-v5.0.1-alpha-5-ppsa99170.zip size: 20.0 mb; what it is: the install steps in short ps5 mihawkos-v5.0.1-alpha-5-sha256sums size: 40 kb; what it is: the sha-256 of every file in both folders: sha256sum -c checks a copy ps5 mihawkos-v5.0.1-alpha-5-zips.sha256 size: 1 kb;
